title: CNC Tool-Wear Runtime Counter
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cnc:job
| stats sum(runtime_min) as runtime_min by tool_id
| where runtime_min>600
| sort - runtime_min
description: Uses CNC job runtime logs telemetry to monitor how long each tool has actually been cutting in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for wear items that are approaching replacement windows, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest CNC job runtime logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how long each tool has actually been cutting so you can spot wear items that are approaching replacement windows before it becomes annoying.
